verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification platform with integrations, webhooks and a Zapier connector, so versioning automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review, or rollback of automations or flow configurations. The 'review' material covers manual review of verification sessions, the migration guide covers SDK versions, and Zapier is a third-party automation platform; none of these is the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
